cards.title: Should We Move Before Daughter Starts School?
cards.body: A parent weighs relocating closer to family against the difficulty of forming new friendships in their current area. The advice column explores both the financial and emotional costs of each decision.

cards.title: Music Doesn't Define Kids Like It Did Us
cards.body: A parent learns to appreciate their children's musical tastes rather than dismissing them as inferior. The essay challenges the notion that music preferences are a mark of cultural superiority.

cards.title: What Parents Should Know About Campus Sexual Assault
cards.body: Parents can maintain open dialogue with children about sexual safety and encourage colleges to prevent campus sexual violence. This conversation is critical before children leave home.

cards.title: Face-to-Face Contact Improves Surrogacy Journeys
cards.body: Weekly in-person meetings with your surrogate can enhance the experience and create memories to share with your future child. Regular contact may also prevent complications.

cards.title: Treatment Now Available for Child Dementia
cards.body: A five-year-old with dementia can access a new treatment available in the US, though funding for UK children remains unclear. The £3m therapy offers hope but financial barriers persist.
